correctness.rationale: For every characteristic simplex, affine endpoint inequalities establish fixed first/second nearest vertices and facets, giving exactly U=lambda_vertex and V=lambda_facet. Uniform simplex barycentric coordinates are Dirichlet with d+1 unit parameters. The resulting joint density, normalization, support, covariance and exponential limit follow algebraically. The supporting-hyperplane definition avoids ambiguous projections to finite facet sets. 3D sampling corroborates but does not certify the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: Natural joint robustness of vertex and supporting-facet decisions has universal, nontrivial dependence: support exclusion U+V<=1, negative correlation -1/d, and an independent-exponential high-dimensional limit. Neither marginal alone determines these features, and the statement spans all convex regular-polytope types, not an arbitrary finite slice.
